meta.title: Migrate from NextJS to RedwoodJS
meta.body_summary: Migrate the entire application from NextJS to RedwoodJS to reduce bundle size and improve code organization, adding a GraphQL API layer and RedwoodJS project structure.

perf_labels.notes: Massive framework migration (25k+ line changes) with only narrative perf claims; maintainer immediately closed without review, indicating scope was unacceptable for agent-authored PR.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Very large change by absolute volume (98% from lockfile), representing a full framework rewrite that would require extensive review and testing. As a sweeping architectural migration, the scale is inconsistent with a lightweight perf PR and the closure without engagement aligns with maintainer rejection of such a large unverified contribution.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or comment text exists; the maintainer unassigned the agent and closed the PR within ~15 minutes without explanation.
review_details.performance_claim: Smaller bundle size through RedwoodJS's optimized build process, GraphQL efficiency, and automatic code splitting.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer unassigned Copilot and closed PR immediately; the massive change scale (25k+ lines) likely made review impractical, suggesting the scope was too large for an agent-generated PR.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Full framework migration (NextJS → RedwoodJS) is a high-risk, large-scale change that demands significant review and testing investment. The agent's output, while structurally consistent, was not accepted at all, indicating that such sweeping architectural changes are beyond the project's acceptance process for automated contributions without prior benchmarks or incremental approach.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance evidence provided; only narrative claims of bundle size improvement without before/after metrics or benchmarks.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge with no post-rejection fixes or cycles.

core_change_summary.description: Added RedwoodJS dependencies (massive pnpm-lock.yaml churn) and created a RedwoodJS project structure with api/ (GraphQL schema, services, auth) and web/ (pages, layouts, App) directories, establishing the new framework scaffold.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The change is dominated by lockfile modifications; new API and web files are mostly boilerplate scaffolding for the RedwoodJS framework.
change_trajectory: Add RedwoodJS core dependencies, producing 25k+ line lockfile updates.
Setup RedwoodJS project structure with api/ and web/ directories, adding GraphQL, services, and front-end pages.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR linked to issue #46 (migration request).
Within ~15 minutes, maintainer unibeck unassigned the agent and closed the PR without any comment or review.
No human-agent interaction occurred; the change was rejected solely based on scope/presented code.
